check_is_offline_mode: check if the huggingface hub is in offline mode by calling is_offline_mode()
get_hf_home_path: get the huggingface home cache path from HF_HOME or fallback to XDG_CACHE_HOME
resolve_repo_url: resolve a huggingface repo URL template with repo_id, revision, and filename placeholders
map_repo_type: map a repo type string like datasets or spaces to its canonical REPO_TYPE constant
parse_env_true_value: parse an environment variable string and return True if it matches a true value like 1, ON, or TRUE
